usecase.name: [QA Validation App] UJ-17 Execution Split Panel
usecase.description: Selecting a run in the Execution History table opens its details in a split panel at the bottom of the use case page (header 'Execution <id>', Execution Steps table, deep link ?tab=history&execution=<id>); closing the panel clears the selection and the URL; Delete removes the selected run and closes the panel

steps.instruction: Focus the username field
Focus the password field
Click the 'Sign in' button
Open /usecase/069b14f8-9c4e-4fe7-a0bb-02467a31bb49
Is the use case '[QA Validation App] Login' shown in the page header?
Click the 'Trigger Execution' button
Click the 'Execution History' tab
Click the 'Refresh' button above the 'Execution History' table
Does the first row of the 'Execution History' table have a radio button in its first cell?
Is there a panel at the bottom of the page whose header starts with 'Execution'?
Click the radio button of the first row in the 'Execution History' table; a panel opens at the bottom of the page
Is there a panel at the bottom of the page whose header starts with 'Execution'?
tab=history&execution=[0-9a-f-]+
The URL carries the history tab and the selected execution
Is there a section with the heading 'Execution Information' in the panel at the bottom of the page?
Scroll down inside the panel at the bottom of the page to the table with the heading 'Execution Steps'
Is there a table with the heading 'Execution Steps' in the panel at the bottom of the page?
Click the 'Close panel' icon button (the X) in the header of the panel at the bottom of the page; the panel disappears
Is there a panel at the bottom of the page whose header starts with 'Execution'?
\?tab=history$
Closing the panel dropped the execution parameter from the URL
Is the radio button of the first row in the 'Execution History' table selected?
Click the radio button of the first row in the 'Execution History' table; a panel opens at the bottom of the page
Click the 'Delete' button above the 'Execution History' table
Is a dialog with the header 'Delete Executions' shown?
Does the dialog say 'You are about to permanently delete 1 execution.'?
Type 'permanently delete' in the confirmation field of the dialog
Click the 'Delete' button in the dialog
Is the 'Delete Executions' dialog closed?
Is there a panel at the bottom of the page whose header starts with 'Execution'?
